text.tspan: 1. Most benchmarks are single-turn, while most LLM interactions now are multi-turn.
2. English remains overrepresented in multilingual evaluation, but local benchmarks align better with
human judgments than translated ones, and reasoning performance is sensitive to language.
3. Games allow algorithmic scoring or tightly constrained “LLM-as-a-rule-enforcer” judges.
4. Pointwise evaluation on fixed games computes each model's score independently.
MTGBench – a bilingual (English and Russian) multi-turn benchmark of seven games combining
algorithmic checkers and a human-validated LLM rule-enforcer.

tspan.tspan: Total normalized score (mean over 7 games, 100 instances per game and language).

text.tspan: Models are sorted by Total. Whiskers show 95% bootstrap CIs.
The Russian penalty is a letter-game effect. Per-game scores in English and Russian for six models (AO and
Reason), sorted by English Total. On letter games Russian trails English, most for weaker and AO models; on
semantic games the two languages stay at near parity.

g.title: Wordle — MTGBench
g.desc: ALGORITHMIC · SPEED. Guess a five-letter word using color-coded feedback. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.inkscape:label: Wheel Of Fortune
g.title: Wheel of Fortune — MTGBench
g.desc: ALGORITHMIC · SPEED. Reveal a hidden word by guessing letters or the whole word. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.inkscape:label: Word Chain
g.title: Word Chain — MTGBench
g.desc: ALGORITHMIC · SURVIVAL. Chain city names by their last letters without repeats or invalid moves. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.inkscape:label: Situation Puzzles
g.title: Situation Puzzles — MTGBench
g.desc: LLM JUDGE · SPEED. Uncover a puzzling scenario’s hidden explanation by asking yes/no questions. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.text: No ticket, yet he skips the queue.

g.inkscape:label: 20 Features
g.title: 20 Features — MTGBench
g.desc: LLM JUDGE · SPEED. Identify an object from sequentially revealed clues. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.title: Alias — MTGBench
g.desc: LLM JUDGE · SPEED. Identify a famous person by asking yes/no questions. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.

g.inkscape:label: 20 Questions
g.title: 20 Questions — MTGBench
g.desc: ALGORITHMIC · SURVIVAL. Answer yes/no questions about an invented word that resembles a real one, staying consistent with its given attributes. Vector research card with a textured fantasy frame. Illustrative gameplay example.
